newsitem.title: RUSSIA: New Norilsk exporter handles cobalt, too-source.
newsitem.headline: New Norilsk exporter handles cobalt, too-source.

text.p: A source at Russian metals group Norilsk Nickel, which is using a new exclusive exporter and foreign agent for its nickel and copper sales, said on Friday that the agent handles cobalt sales as well.
The source, who declined to be named, said Interrosimpex (formerly known as Interrosimpeks) had been agent for Norilsky Nikel foreign metal sales, including cobalt, since July.
Russia's exports of platinum, palladium and platinum-group metals, most produced by Norilsk, are done by the government.
Interrosimpex is part of a financial-industrial group that includes Uneximbank, MFK Bank and Norilsk.
The source said Norilsk's long-term plan was for Interrosimpex to act as exclusive exporter, delivering metals to Norilsk's London-based subsidiary Normaco Ltd for distribution.
The changes are part of Norilsk's plan to improve the way its sells metals on world markets and to boost profits.
Normaco previously negotiated contracts for Norilsk's foreign metals sales and is carrying out contracts signed before July. --Peter Henderson, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
